create_multi_optimizer: create a MultiOptimizer container wrapping multiple PyTorch optimizers as a single optimizer
build_optimizer_step: build a training step that calls MultiOptimizer.step with an optional closure for multi-optimizer updates
test_zero_grad: test MultiOptimizer.zero_grad to clear gradients across all wrapped optimizers
review_state_dict: review MultiOptimizer.state_dict and load_state_dict for serializing and restoring optimizer state
summarize_optimizers_property: summarize the MultiOptimizer.optimizers property to access the list of wrapped optimizers
